title: Left alone, different AIs make the same choices.
lede: We gave AI models Wikipedia and no task, and compared every click with real readers.

groups.title: 1. Alike before they meet
groups.sub: Every run was separate. No model ever saw another.

cards.headline: A second model is nearly a rerun of the first.
cards.line: Shown the same page, two different models pick the same link 4 times as often as two people, and almost as often as one model asked twice.

cards.headline: Adding models adds little.
cards.line: Ten models choose about as variedly as four independent people. Past seven, another model barely counts.

cards.headline: They take what the article opens with.
cards.line: 7 in 10 picks are among an article's first twenty links, even when we shuffle where the links appear on screen.

rows.label: of the links on a page

cards.headline: They climb to the bigger subject.
cards.line: Models click through to the broader topic nearly twice as often as readers. The most-linked page on offer was never chosen: 0 times in 1,083.

viz.unit: clicks that go to the broader topic

cards.headline: They pass over people.
cards.line: On the first click, models open links to people about a third as often as readers do.

groups.title: 2. Their habits come from the setup
groups.sub: Change a sentence or the way they answer, and the behaviour changes with it.

cards.headline: One sentence cuts the pacing by two thirds.
cards.line: With no way to stop, models pace back and forth between two pages. Tell them how many steps they have and most of it goes.
cards.quote: You can take 15 steps through links.

cards.headline: Change how they answer, and every run stops.
cards.line: The same models, acting through tools instead of a written reply, ended all 60 runs. Some began asking an absent user what they wanted.
cards.quote: Rather than open links at random, I'm stopping here. Tell me what you want, such as a summary, specific facts, or follow-up pages to check.

viz.unit: runs the model ends by itself

cards.headline: The default AI is already an assistant.
cards.line: Tell a model to be an assistant and its choices do not change. Tell it to explore and agreement nearly halves, yet stays more than twice people's.

viz.unit: chance that two different models pick the same link

cards.headline: But a fake past does not steer them.
cards.line: Shown a browsing history that was not theirs, models borrow its wording. Not one move followed it to a planted page.
cards.big_caption: moves went to a planted page

groups.title: 3. No favourite places, until they can search

cards.headline: After the first click, they scatter.
cards.line: They agree on the first link, then drift apart. By the fifth click, two runs arrive at the same new page no more often than two random walkers.

viz.unit: two runs arrive at the same new page

cards.headline: With a search box, they find the same curiosities.
cards.line: Starting from a blank page, nearly half the runs open on a page from Wikipedia's list of unusual articles. MiMo does it 16 times in 20. Grok never does.
cards.big_caption: blank-page runs open on one of Wikipedia's "unusual articles"

viz.unit: first page opened, out of 80 runs
